dedupe_keys.name: routezero electric bus energy consumption and depot charging optimisation model

description: RouteZero integrates a data-driven model of electric bus energy consumption with an optimisation of depot charging that minimises the load on the grid, as described in a 2024 article in npj Sustainable Mobility and Transport. It needs only public inputs: typical weather, GTFS route and timetable data and bus battery capacities and weights. The energy model extends a linear regression approach with Bayesian regression, fitted on data from 40 buses in Sydney; the case study covers a depot in Belconnen, ACT, serving 18 routes. Code and model-fit data are in the GitHub repository, and a web tool is hosted by the Australian National University. Coverage: any network with GTFS data. Format and access: Python package and web tool. Licence and cost: AGPL-3.0 code; article CC BY 4.0; free. Caveats: timetables do not say which bus runs which trip, so energy is computed in aggregate. It supports optimisation and capacity planning of electrified bus depots and their grid connection. It relates to the depot charging load profiles, the GTFS specification and the Istanbul clean bus fleet case in the catalogue.
